note: Calendar used by the Phase 2.1 data-quality layer. Evidence tiers: A = multiple independent secondary sources AND absence in both vendor series (1-minute and daily); B = absence in both vendor series AND on the Phase 1 calendar AND a standard NSE festival, not individually re-verified in Phase 2.1. The NSE circulars themselves could not be read directly (nseindia.com was not queried); this is therefore secondary-source evidence.

market_structure_changes.description: From 2026-08-03 continuous trading in F&O-eligible stocks (all NIFTY 50 constituents) ends at 15:15 and a Closing Auction Session follows; the index does not update during the auction and the official close appears at the end. In the vendor 1-minute data this is a frozen price from 15:15/15:16 to 15:27/15:28 followed by one catch-up bar (15:28 in 9 sessions, 15:29 in 12) whose close equals the 15:30 print and the official close.
evidence: https://groww.in/blog/nse-extends-f-and-o-trading-hours-by-10-minutes-new-timings-effective-from-august-3-2026
https://www.sahi.com/blogs/closing-auction-session-cas-explained-nse-bse-closing-price-rules-2026
https://www.oquilia.com/markets/today/2026-08-03 (close 24,774.30, equals vendor daily and 15:30 print)
data: 21/21 sessions 2026-08-03..08-31 show the pattern; 19/19 in Oct 2026 and 21/21 in Sep 2026 (diagnostic download); 0 sessions before 2026-08-03
market_structure_changes.confidence: HIGH for the regime start date and the data pattern (data + 2 sources + exact external close); the NSE circular was not read directly
